readings.title: 电梯坏了
readings.levelSuggestionZh: 教学建议大约 A2，未经认证分级。写一次电梯停用、自己走楼梯回家再出门买面包的经过。
readings.narratorNote: 原创学习短文，不是真人经历或转载语料。人物不是助手或用户本人。

paragraphs.en: I live on the seventh floor of a small building. I go out almost every day, so I usually don't think about the elevator at all. I just press the button and wait. Most of the time, I don't even notice it.
paragraphs.zh: 我住在一栋小楼的七层。我几乎天天出门，所以平时很少想电梯的事。按一下按钮，等一等就好。大多数时候，我甚至不会注意到它。

paragraphs.en: Last Tuesday I came home from the store with two heavy bags of food. I pressed the button as usual, but nothing happened.
paragraphs.zh: 上周二，我从商店回家，手里提着两袋很沉的食物。我照常按下按钮，可是什么也没发生。

paragraphs.en: A note on the elevator door said it was out, and someone would come to fix it in the afternoon. I looked at the stairs and then at my bags.
paragraphs.zh: 电梯门上有一张纸条，说电梯坏了，下午会有人来修。我看了看楼梯，又看了看手里的袋子。

paragraphs.en: I started walking up slowly, one floor at a time. I stopped on the third floor to rest, and again on the fifth. My arms were tired, but I did not want to make two trips.
paragraphs.zh: 我开始慢慢往上走，一层一层来。在三楼停下来歇了歇，到五楼又歇了一次。胳膊已经酸了，可我不想分两次搬。

paragraphs.en: On the sixth floor I met a man who was also walking up. He smiled and said, "The elevator is out again." We didn't really talk. We just kept going.
paragraphs.zh: 到六楼时，我遇到一个也在往上走的人。他笑了笑说：“电梯又坏了。”我们没怎么聊，只是接着走。

paragraphs.en: When I finally got home, I put the bags on the table, drank some water, and sat down for a few minutes. The walk had taken much longer than the elevator ever did.
paragraphs.zh: 终于到家后，我把袋子放在桌上，喝了点水，坐了几分钟。这段路比坐电梯要久得多。

paragraphs.en: In the afternoon I had planned to go back out for a short walk. I almost stayed in, because I did not want to face the stairs again.
paragraphs.zh: 下午我本来打算再出去走一会儿。我差点就待在家里了，因为不想再面对那截楼梯。

paragraphs.en: Then I thought about dinner. I still needed bread. I took only a small bag this time, went down more slowly, and tried not to carry too much.
paragraphs.zh: 后来我想起晚饭。我还缺面包。这次我只带了个小袋子，下楼也更慢，尽量不提太多东西。

paragraphs.en: The stairs were quiet, and the air in the stairwell was cool. I got the bread downstairs and climbed back up without stopping as long as before.
paragraphs.zh: 楼梯间很安静，空气也凉快。我在楼下买到面包，再爬上来时，停歇没有刚才那么久。

paragraphs.en: The elevator was working again the next morning. I was glad. Still, I learned something simple: if I have to take the stairs, I should not carry too much at once.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早上，电梯又可以用了。我挺高兴。不过我也明白了一件简单的事：要是得走楼梯，就不要一次带太多东西。

notes.expression: The elevator is out / it was out
notes.meaningZh: 电梯坏了、停用了。这里的 is out 不是“卖完了”（We're out of），也不是“在外面”。口语里也常说 The elevator is out of order。
走楼梯；爬楼梯。这里的 take 不是把楼梯拿走。

notes.expression: seventh floor / one floor at a time
notes.meaningZh: 七层；一层一层地。floor 复用已有“楼层”义项，不是地板。

notes.expression: from the store / I just press the button and wait
notes.meaningZh: 从商店回来；按下按钮等一等。store、wait 复用已有词卡。

optionalTakeaways.en: If I have to take the stairs, I should not carry too much at once.
optionalTakeaways.zh: 要是得走楼梯，就不要一次带太多东西。

readings.title: 改约了时间
readings.levelSuggestionZh: 教学建议大约 A2+，未经认证分级。写一次因临时帮忙而改约、朋友表示理解、稍后仍见面的经过。
readings.narratorNote: 原创学习短文，不是真人经历或转载语料。人物不是助手或用户本人。

paragraphs.en: On Thursday I made a plan with my friend Owen. We would meet on Saturday at one, have coffee near the park, and then walk along the river if the weather stayed nice.
paragraphs.zh: 周四，我和朋友欧文约好了。周六一点见面，先在公园附近喝咖啡，要是天气一直不错，再沿着河边走走。

paragraphs.en: I was looking forward to it all week. We hadn't seen each other in a few weeks, and I had already checked the weather. Saturday looked fine.
paragraphs.zh: 我一周都在盼着这件事。我们有几个星期没见了，而且我已经看过天气。周六看起来不错。

paragraphs.en: Friday evening, my cousin Mina called. She was moving a few things to a new apartment on Saturday morning, and the friend who had promised to help couldn't come. She sounded tired, and a little embarrassed to ask. She asked if I could give her two hours.
paragraphs.zh: 周五晚上，表妹米娜打电话来。她周六上午要把一些东西搬到新公寓，原先答应来帮忙的朋友来不了了。她听起来有些累，开口时也有点不好意思。她问我能不能给她两个小时。

paragraphs.en: I wanted to help her. I also did not want to cancel on Owen. For a while I just sat with the phone in my hand, trying to think of a time that could work for both of us.
paragraphs.zh: 我想帮她，可也不想对欧文失约。有一会儿，我只是拿着手机坐着，想找一个两个人都能接受的时间。

paragraphs.en: Then I messaged Owen and told him the truth, even though I felt bad about changing the plan. Something had come up, and I asked if we could meet later, maybe at three thirty, after I finished helping Mina.
paragraphs.zh: 后来我还是给欧文发了消息，把实情告诉他，尽管为改计划觉得有些过意不去。临时有事，我问他能不能晚一点见，也许三点半，等我帮完米娜之后。

paragraphs.en: I was afraid he would be disappointed. He wrote back a few minutes later: "That's fine. I'd rather go later than not go at all. Text me when you're on the way."
paragraphs.zh: 我担心他会失望。几分钟后他回过来说：“可以。晚一点去，也比不去好。你上路了给我发个消息。”

paragraphs.en: Saturday morning I went to Mina's place a little after nine. The work was simple but slow: a narrow stair, a heavy bookshelf, and a few bags. We carried things down carefully and finished a little after two.
paragraphs.zh: 周六早上九点刚过，我到了米娜那里。活儿并不复杂，可是很慢：楼梯窄，书架沉，还有几只袋子。我们小心地把东西搬下去，两点刚过才做完。

paragraphs.en: I went home, washed my hands, and changed my shirt. I sat down for a minute, then got ready. I was more tired than I had expected, and I almost asked to reschedule again. I didn't. I had already changed the time once.
paragraphs.zh: 我回了家，洗了手，换了件衬衫。先坐了一分钟，再去收拾。我比预想的更累，差点又想再改一次时间。可我没有。时间已经改过一次了。

paragraphs.en: I left at three, walked most of the way, and got to the cafe a few minutes before three thirty. Owen was already there, with a table by the window. He had ordered tea for both of us.
paragraphs.zh: 我三点出门，大半路程是走着去的，三点半前几分钟到了咖啡馆。欧文已经在窗边的位子上等着，还为我们两人都点了茶。

paragraphs.en: I thanked him for changing the time. He shrugged and said plans change, as long as people say so early enough. We drank our tea slowly and talked about Mina's new place. Then we walked by the river until it started to get dark.
paragraphs.zh: 我谢他愿意改时间。他耸了耸肩，说计划总会变，只要人家说得够早。我们慢慢喝着茶，聊起米娜的新住处。然后沿着河边走，一直走到天快黑。

paragraphs.en: It was not the afternoon I had first imagined, but it was still a good one. Next time, I will look at my weekend more carefully before I say yes to two things. And I will say so sooner, if I have to reschedule.
paragraphs.zh: 这并不是我起初想象的那个下午，但仍然很好。下一次，在同时答应两件事之前，我会先把周末看清楚一点。而且如果必须改约，我会更早说出来。

notes.expression: I had to reschedule / if I have to reschedule
notes.meaningZh: 我只好改时间了；如果必须改约。reschedule 是改约定的时间，不是直接取消（cancel）。
临时有事。复用已有词卡 Something came up，这里用过去完成时，意思一样。

notes.expression: meet later / a few minutes later
notes.meaningZh: 晚一点见面；几分钟后。later 复用已有“稍后”义项。

notes.expression: Text me when you're on the way
notes.meaningZh: 你上路了给我发个消息。on the way 复用已有“在路上”义项。cancel on someone 是对别人失约，本课只在叙述里出现，不单建新卡。

optionalTakeaways.en: I'd rather go later than not go at all.

wordCards.collocation: The elevator is out / the elevator was out / it was out
wordCards.transferEn: The elevator is out, so we'll have to meet in the lobby.
wordCards.transferZh: 电梯坏了，我们只好在大厅见。
wordCards.notesZh: The elevator is out 是电梯坏了、暂时不能用。这里的 out 不是“卖完了”（We're out of），也不是“在外面”。和 break down 接近，但电梯口语里常这样说，也常说 out of order。另境例句改到在大厅会合，不用本篇提着购物袋爬楼的场面。

wordCards.collocation: take the stairs / have to take the stairs / I took the stairs
wordCards.exampleEn: If I have to take the stairs, I should not carry too much at once.
wordCards.exampleZh: 要是得走楼梯，就不要一次带太多东西。
wordCards.transferEn: The line for the elevator was long, so I took the stairs.
wordCards.transferZh: 等电梯的人很多，所以我走了楼梯。
wordCards.notesZh: take the stairs 是改走楼梯。这里的 take 不是把楼梯拿走。单独出现的 the stairs 也常是同一意思。另境例句改到电梯排队很长，不用本篇提着食物回家的场面。

wordCards.collocation: reschedule / I had to reschedule / if I have to reschedule
wordCards.exampleEn: I almost asked to reschedule again.
wordCards.exampleZh: 我差点又想再改一次时间。
wordCards.transferEn: I had a fever, so I had to reschedule my haircut.
wordCards.transferZh: 我发烧了，所以只好改了理发的时间。
wordCards.notesZh: reschedule 是把约定改到另一个时间，不是直接取消（cancel）。I had to reschedule 常表示“只好改时间了”。另境例句改到改理发时间，不用本篇帮表妹搬家后再见面的场面。
